_note: The vendor application page, 2026-09-20, a spoke of /preferred-vendors/ (the list is the hub, this is the way onto it). Drafted to the global copy law; Daniel edits after. Anyone with the link can apply (Daniel, 2026-09-20), so the page is indexed and the form is open. The offer is the listing itself: a card with the city, his two sentences and a dofollow link to their site, free, with nothing asked in return. The music library the handoff offered is dead ('i don't want to offer a music library anymore'), so nothing here promises one. The CTA is the Google Form in site.json brand.forms.vendor, owned by Daniel's own account; the starting price it asks for never publishes back. No nav key.
title: Join the Preferred Vendor List | Signet Artists
